Gaja Kesari Yoga.name: Gaja Kesari Yoga
Gaja Kesari Yoga.description: Jupiter and Moon in mutual Kendras (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th from each other). Indicates wisdom, success, wealth, status, and protection from negative transits.

Budhaditya Yoga.name: Budhaditya Yoga
Budhaditya Yoga.description: Sun and Mercury in the same house. Indicates intelligence, excellent communication, sharp intellect, learning capacity, and professional success.

Ruchaka Yoga.name: Ruchaka Yoga (Pancha Mahapurusha)
Ruchaka Yoga.description: Mars in a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) in its own sign (Aries/Scorpio) or exalted sign (Capricorn). Indicates leadership, physical strength, courage, and victory over obstacles.

Bhadra Yoga.name: Bhadra Yoga (Pancha Mahapurusha)
Bhadra Yoga.description: Mercury in a Kendra in its own/exalted sign (Gemini/Virgo). Indicates high intelligence, mercantile success, business acumen, and eloquence.

Hamsa Yoga.name: Hamsa Yoga (Pancha Mahapurusha)
Hamsa Yoga.description: Jupiter in a Kendra in its own sign (Sagittarius/Pisces) or exalted sign (Cancer). Indicates spiritual wisdom, righteousness, pure character, and societal honor.

Malavya Yoga.name: Malavya Yoga (Pancha Mahapurusha)
Malavya Yoga.description: Venus in a Kendra in its own sign (Taurus/Libra) or exalted sign (Pisces). Indicates luxury, artistic abilities, happy relationships, charm, and high comfort in life.

Sasa Yoga.name: Sasa Yoga (Pancha Mahapurusha)
Sasa Yoga.description: Saturn in a Kendra in its own sign (Capricorn/Aquarius) or exalted sign (Libra). Indicates patience, organization, political or administrative power, and long-term achievements.

Kala Sarpa Yoga.name: Kala Sarpa Yoga
Kala Sarpa Yoga.description: All planets are hemmed between Rahu and Ketu in the chart. Indicates intense cycles, early life struggles, followed by unexpected rises or transformations.
